about: A 4:3 PNG, 240 × 180, placed on a 16:9 timeline of 320 × 180 with nothing else. It must last the default still length, five seconds (DEFAULT_IMAGE_DURATION in concat-project), and be fitted unscaled in the middle with a black bar of 40 pixels either side, in every frame. A failure means a still's length, its framing or its bars changed.
